annotations.title: Bitcoin price: BTC in USD, EUR and more

description: Bitcoin price now: the current BTC spot price in USD, EUR, GBP, CAD, CHF, AUD and JPY, averaged across major exchanges, with satoshis per US dollar and the time of the price; name a currency such as SEK or INR for one more. No input needed. Use to value a Bitcoin or Lightning payment, convert between sats and fiat, or check the BTC price before a trade. Example: currency=SEK. Price $0.002/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

currency.description: Optional: also price BTC in this currency; the seven listed ones come from the source, others (SEK, NOK, INR, BRL and about 25 more) are converted from USD at the ECB reference rate
